en: Black‑and‑white view of a large three‑storey historicist building with a clock tower in the center of the façade. The structure has many evenly spaced windows, ornate window pediments, and a steep roof with dormers. A wrought‑iron fence and gate line the street, with leafless trees planted along the sidewalk. Several pedestrians, including two boys with a bicycle, walk on a broad, unpaved or lightly paved street in the foreground. The sky area is blank and overexposed. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
